audit_policy: The preassigned pool_audit role is excluded from model selection and fitting; it is evaluated only after the development-LOSO winner is fixed.
best_model_selection: maximum pooled development LOSO AUPRC; ties within 1e-12 break by lower Brier, then lower ECE, then lexical model id
calibration: Nested group-held-out Platt calibration for M1/TCN/GRU LOSO; final calibrators use only model_calibration after base fitting on model_train.
main_evaluation: exact leave-one-(source_dataset,session_id)-out over binary-labeled development rows, pooled out-of-fold metrics

models.M1_CALIBRATED_LOGISTIC: M0 base plus group-held-out Platt calibration

runtime_feature_policy: Only numeric runtime-visible features from STAGE_A_FEATURE_SCHEMA plus query code and witness class in temporal inputs; source/session/call/unit/anchor/event/oracle fields are forbidden.
temporal_input: fixed 64-step pre-label YOLO/ByteTrack sequence with query one-hot and witness-class one-hot; no RGB backbone
uncertainty_policy: AUPRC is undefined for one-class slices; such slices remain reported with null AUPRC. Leave-one-dataset-out is NOT_IDENTIFIABLE when only one source dataset exists.
